create_rgb_color_variation: create an RgbVariation instance with independent r, g, b, and alpha channel values
create_hsv_color_variation: create an HsvVariation instance with independent h, s, v, and alpha channel values
create_gray_color_variation: create a GrayVariation instance with a gray_level and optional alpha value
evaluate_rgb_variation: call an RgbVariation instance to generate an RGBA numpy array from variation values
evaluate_hsv_variation: call an HsvVariation instance to generate an RGBA numpy array from HSV variation values
